not_claimable_as: fully end-to-end independently nested CV results
meta_level_oof_disclosure: Phase25C's 3-fold upstream cross-fit and Phase25F's 5-fold downstream cross-validation are NOT a fully nested end-to-end hierarchy: the refined-probability features seen by a Phase25F fold were produced by a Phase25C refiner that was not cross-fit with respect to that Phase25F fold. Phase25F OOF predictions are therefore META_LEVEL_OOF_DEVELOPMENT_PREDICTIONS, suitable for Phase25G development evaluation only.
